feature: ordinary Health Gate local resource failure backoff

behavior.local_errors: ReconnectingWatch returns OutOfMemory and ConcurrencyUnavailable to its polling caller; the ordinary background Gate publishes not_serving and sleeps using the Watch exponential backoff policy rather than polling immediately
behavior.count: successfully returned Watch events reset the local failure count; ordinary poll timeouts preserve current state and failure count
behavior.cancellation: backoff sleep is cancellable; Gate deinit cancels and joins its worker before releasing state; worker teardown owns Watch connection resources
behavior.terminal: HealthWatchStopped publishes rejected and exits; HealthWatchDisabled publishes serving and exits
behavior.test_discovery: grpc/mod.zig explicitly imports channel/health_gate.zig so filtered tests discover private Gate regressions without relying on unrelated named tests

interop_debug.scope: ordinary Watch retry/CONNECTING/capacity recovery and disabled connection release; original response-policy and shared-stream scenarios

new_fault_regressions: real peer sends GOAWAY plus UNAVAILABLE, then allocations fail persistently during replacement setup; blocked local retry preserves failure count; a second failure increases backoff; restored resources complete a health-gated unary call

real peer sends GOAWAY plus UNAVAILABLE, then custom connector returns persistent ConcurrencyUnavailable; blocked local retry preserves failure count; restored connector completes a health-gated unary call
both resource faults remain active while Channel closes; cancellable retry is joined and direct TCP input observes EOF or reset rather than using HTTP/2 accept retirement as proof
verification.fault_isolation: Watch owner thread is identified by the real connector; retry barriers apply only to that owner, while independent socket-write timer tasks keep normal I/O behavior

verification_commands: zig build test-lib -Dtest-filter='health gate' -Dtest-filter='reconnecting health Watch' --summary all
limitations: the new executor fault matrix exercises custom connector admission after transport retirement; it does not prove the separate already-sent Watch response-read admission failure cleanup path
multi-hour/high-concurrency stability and broader gRPC composite/xDS integration remain open for the full goal
